title: A live model prompt is assembled through an explicit boundary that admits only public state
summary: When a live model acts inside a larger system, every prompt field is provenance- or disclosure-labelled and the boundary admits only public state plus the acting party's own private material. Observer narration, other parties' private state, engine/RNG state and SECRET/INTERNAL material are fail-closed before the provider is invoked.
evidence_note: psychic-poker prompt-boundary audit v0.7.38: PokerPromptEnvelope admits only public table state plus the acting player's own hole-card field; SECRET/INTERNAL material is fail-closed before provider invocation; live prompt audits persist counts and SHA-512 identity only, never the prompt text.
invariants: A live actor receives no hidden strategy, psychic observation, or other-agent private material.
Speech to a live actor is evidence, not truth: it reveals no hidden cards and does not change the actor's objective.
Keep an audit trail of what crossed the boundary by identity/digest, not by copying secret prompt contents into logs.
A probe that questions the model twice on identical public state is evidence of sensitivity, not proof of causation; label projections as claims unless the paired control reproduced them.
